name: agentic-codebase
description: Analyzes your repo and your local Claude Code transcripts, finds the work you repeat and the guardrails you are missing, and builds a customized agentic setup (CLAUDE.md, rules, hooks, skills, subagents, MCP drafts) from that evidence. Writes a plan you approve before it creates a single file. Use it to set up Claude Code for a repo, audit an existing .claude/ setup, or turn repeated prompts into skills.
